name: Wutuobang Zhi Xue
source:
In the year circa XXXX, the first Utopian country in human history has declared its independence and established itself among the world nations as a new country.However, due to the malevolent influences of foreign media and the naivety of its young, immature government, Utpia was inundated with immigration, ravaged by overpopulation, and crushed under the economic and sociopolitical pressure from such an unforgiving transformation. In merely 10 years, the original Utpia deteriorated into the human zoo of hell that it is today. Unable to witness the unsightly state of corruption Utpia has descended into, the legislators signed into law a madman decision to authorize the killing of other individuals -- murder -- as a legal, legitimate act. The profession of murderers will not be interfered with by the government in any way, but only under the circumstance that no other citizen knows about it. If anyone is to find out about the murder and has sufficient evidence to incriminate and prove one guilty, the murderer will be convicted and executed.

In the distant land of the 18th ward in Utpia, a young murderer named Pekah Aldrich just woke from his dark, somnolent dream, about to go into the finals weeks of his life-changing sophomore year of high school.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818220/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
大约在XXXX年，人类历史上第一个乌托邦国家宣布独立，并作为一个新国家跻身于世界民族之林。然而，由于外国媒体的恶毒影响和年轻不成熟政府的幼稚，乌托邦被移民淹没，人口过剩所蹂躏，在如此无情的转型带来的经济和社会政治压力下被压垮。仅仅十年的时间，最初的乌特皮亚就退化成了今天的人类地狱动物园。立法者们无法目睹乌特皮亚已经陷入的丑陋腐败状况，因此将一项疯狂的决定签署为法律，授权杀害其他人——谋杀——作为一种合法、合法的行为。杀人犯的职业不会受到政府以任何方式的干涉，但只有在没有其他公民知道的情况下才可以。如果有人发现这起谋杀案，并有足够的证据来定罪并证明有罪，凶手将被定罪并被处决。

在遥远的乌特皮亚第18区，一个名叫佩卡·奥尔德里奇的年轻杀人犯刚刚从黑暗、昏昏欲睡的梦中醒来，即将进入改变他一生的高中二年级的最后几周。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1818220/]Steam[/url]]
